_about: The For you tab (/next/directory/#foryou, opened from the landing page): what the landing page's AI read in someone's words (topics, place, preferences, safety: build/tools/assist/tags.json) turned into picks and buttons by the rules here. No AI here. Read by build/next/js/for-you.js. topics: for each topic, its line, the service types that make a good first step, words in a name or description that make one better (prefer_words), the groups (who) it suits (groups_ok) and a short name for buttons. open_to_all: the who values that mean anyone can go: the picks only use services open to all (or to a group the topic suits, groups_ok), since we don't know who's asking. score: each candidate gets days until it next runs (within soon_days, only per_day_soon a day, so a group in three weeks isn't far behind one tomorrow) + miles x per_mile, plus a penalty for each way it fits less well (other_area: a service in another area; check_first: one restricted to people we can't tell they are; exact_words: less when it has their own words for an activity; theirs: less for a service for people like them (a veteran's line for a veteran); young: less for a young people's service for someone under 18; activity_on_the_side: more, for an activity, when the service isn't one of activity_types (a breakfast drop-in with a sing-along, rather than a singing group); not_weekly: more for something that meets less than weekly, so a weekly group beats a monthly one that happens to be today; in_name: less again when the activity or their words are in its name, so it's what the group is for); the lowest wins. generic_words: left out of their own words for an activity before matching ("walking group" matches "walks"). talk_lines, main_lines, circumstance_lines, under_18_lines, addiction_words and restrictions: how many lines each topic offers, the established lines for each topic and area, and who a service is only for (each has its own _about). help_types: the kinds of help someone can ask for, as the sheet's types. when_hours: what daytime and evenings mean (a session's start time) and which days are weekends. safety: the panel for each risk group (at most max_picks of its services, in order) (most serious first), its words and the services (sheet record ids) it shows, with more by topic or for under-18s; picks: whether the usual picks show beneath (none, or relevant: only their topics, nothing added). rows: the rows' titles and fold labels; subtitles: the line above each pick. explore: the buttons below the picks (kind_text: a button's line for each kind of service, never naming their need); kind_titles: a button's title for each kind of service.

rows._about: For you's rows, each a cream panel that folds (its chevron by the title; all open when the page loads; the urgent panel never folds). talk: the first row, phone and online services (or, with none, one-to-one services in person); the second row, places to go, named by their place (so it's clearly theirs): groups (all places to meet people) or mixed (some services too); online: no place (online groups only). fold, unfold: the chevron's label for screen readers.

subtitles._about: The line above each pick, said to the person, about what they'd get (never their need: someone else may see the screen). An activity they asked for: activity, or its own words in activity_words when 'A place to enjoy …' doesn't read well; otherwise by_type for the sheet's type, else meet (phone and online picks: listen).

talk_lines._about: Someone you can talk to: how many of each topic's established lines (main_lines, then the best phone or online service) it offers, the topics taking turns, at most max_picks in all. A topic not here: none (its places only).

main_lines._about: The established phone and online services for each topic, by the person's area (Somerset when we don't know it), then national (a national one can come first in an area's own list): sheet record ids, tried in order. Each is still checked against the live record (there, no notice, open to them) and never two from one provider. why: the reason they're here, for whoever maintains this.

low mood.why: NHS talking therapy (self-referral) and the area's listening line

anxiety.why: NHS talking therapy, the area's listening line, then the national anxiety line

bereavement.why: Cruse, the national bereavement charity; the area's bereavement line; practical help after a death

finances.why: the area's Citizens Advice line, then the national debt charities

housing.why: the council's housing and homelessness line, then Shelter

caring for someone.why: the area's carers' service, then Carers UK

dementia.why: the area's dementia support line, then Alzheimer's Society's national line

addiction.why: the area's drug and alcohol service, then gambling support (each only for the addiction they said, when they said one)

eating disorders.why: Beat, the national eating disorder charity

restrictions._about: Who a service is only for (the sheet's restricted_to). area: an area restriction and the area it means: fine when it's their area (from their town; Somerset when we don't know), otherwise never picked. with_topic: fine when they asked about one of these topics (a carer asking about dementia can go to a memory café). check: we can't tell, so it can be picked, after open ones, with this line under it. Anything else (veterans, sight loss, other and so on): never picked, since we don't know who's asking; the directory still shows it. GP practice beside an area value is just the area. who_check: a group (the sheet's who) we can't tell they're in, picked after open ones with this line. who_words: a group they named in their own words for an activity (a men's shed), so it can be picked. A circumstance the person said (a veteran: Armed Forces community) is fine and preferred; an age limit is fine if their age is enough, never if it isn't, and a check line if we don't know it.

check.GP practice: For patients of some GP practices: check with them

check.low income: For people on a low income

circumstance_lines._about: Lines for people in a particular circumstance (the AI's circumstances: build/core/data/restrictions.json), tried before the topic's own main lines when they fit the topic. Sheet record ids, checked like the main lines.

under_18_lines._about: For someone under 18: young people's lines first, by area then national (sheet record ids).

addiction_words._about: When they said what the addiction is (the AI's addiction preference): words in a service's name or description that show which it's for. A service that's only for another kind (Gamblers Anonymous for someone who drinks) isn't picked.
